title: Read the room before the slide

beats.label: Opening line
key_points: Last month I opened on a chart and the front row was still finding seats.
I now wait until notebooks are open, then say the opening line.
The slide is not the talk.
beats.whisper_cue: The slide is not the talk.

beats.label: One story only
key_points: One story only: the chart about onboarding drop-off.

beats.label: Then stop
key_points: Close by repeating "The slide is not the talk."

key_phrases: The slide is not the talk.
do_not: Do not apologize for the time limit.
